patch_description: This crossover retains the independently trainable initial RY layer and the stronger matching-specific phase sandwiches from the best-performing prior design. It adds the inspiration circuit’s distance-two CZ connectivity while omitting its costly controlled rotations and extra mixer stage. A parity-shared final RX layer provides noncommuting population mixing. The result has broader connectivity and improved expressivity with fewer trainable parameters and lower depth than the 0.89-score prior.
